text: 10 OVERDOSAGE RYALTRIS contains both olopatadine hydrochloride and mometasone furoate; therefore, the risks associated with overdosage for the individual components described below apply to RYALTRIS. Olopatadine Hydrochloride: Symptoms of antihistamine overdose may include drowsiness in adults and children. Agitation and restlessness, followed by drowsiness in children. Should overdose occur, symptomatic or supportive treatment is recommended. Mometasone Furoate: Chronic overdosage with any corticosteroid may result in signs or symptoms of hypercorticism [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.6 )] .
